mapper.select: SELECT room_no, parent_email, sitter_email, reg_time, parent_last_read_msg_no, sitter_last_read_msg_no FROM tbl_babysitter_chat_room WHERE parent_email = #{parentEmail} AND sitter_email = #{sitterEmail}

SELECT r.room_no, r.parent_email, r.sitter_email, r.reg_time, r.parent_last_read_msg_no, r.sitter_last_read_msg_no, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_babysitter_chat_message m WHERE m.room_no = r.room_no AND m.sender_email <> #{memberEmail} AND m.msg_no > ( CASE WHEN r.parent_email = #{memberEmail} THEN r.parent_last_read_msg_no ELSE r.sitter_last_read_msg_no END ) ) AS unread_count FROM tbl_babysitter_chat_room r WHERE r.parent_email = #{memberEmail} OR r.sitter_email = #{memberEmail} ORDER BY r.reg_time DESC
SELECT room_no, parent_email, sitter_email, reg_time, parent_last_read_msg_no, sitter_last_read_msg_no FROM tbl_babysitter_chat_room WHERE room_no = #{roomNo}
